title: Parse bounded hospital JSON MRF samples
objective: Hospital JSON samples expose versioned item, charge and payer fields.
outcome: Pin CMS hospital-price-transparency JSON v3.0.0 by repository commit/hash with license and version. Official fictional examples are marked synthetic. The parser never reports an unknown newer version as compatible. A budget stop yields a partial sample, not whole-file validation. Numeric, string, percentage, algorithm and per-diem charge cases remain distinct; none is automatically represented as a comparable dollar price. File-level schema validity is unknown unless the whole required structure was validated. No full-size MRF download is initiated. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.
